description: 黑车困在角落，白象穿越捉死
explanation_en: White opens the bishop's diagonal and attacks the trapped rook in the corner. The queen has no good way to defend it, so Black must give up the exchange.

intro.popup: 💡 困子：黑车在g8几乎动弹不了——被Bf8和角落限制。白方如何利用这个困子？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Trapped piece: Black's rook on g8 has almost no mobility, restricted by the bishop on f8 and the corner. How can White exploit it?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Bxd5开通对角线→Bxg8直接捉死困子！黑车困在角落被迫换象，白方赢得交换。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Bxd5 opens the diagonal, allowing Bxg8 to capture the trapped rook. Black must recapture with the queen, and White wins the exchange.

moves.popup: 白象Bxd5！象从c4吃掉d5兵，打开了通往g8的对角线（d5-e6-f7-g8）。
moves.popup_en: White's bishop captures the pawn on d5, opening the diagonal d5-e6-f7-g8.
Black's bishop moves from f8 to d6 in an attempt to defend.

moves.popup: 白象Bxg8！象从d5沿对角线直取g8困子！黑车几乎没有退路（g7有黑后，h8是死角），被白象吞掉！
moves.popup_en: White's bishop captures the trapped rook on g8 along the diagonal. The rook has almost no escape: g7 is occupied by Black's queen and h8 is a corner square.

moves.popup: 黑后Qxg8吃回，以后换象，白方赢得交换（象换车）大优。
moves.popup_en: Black's queen recaptures on g8. White has exchanged a bishop for a rook and won the exchange.
